test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2998a54b35007e58f081274f978d9f3018744f1fd7bc0793175aa88089a22f0.png]
solution:
According to the given diagram, we can see that at each step one ring is combined with existing group and in the last step, all rings will combine together such that each ring is connected with two neighboring rings.

So the last step will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20c8ca393f8b3aa08404c2628d358fc97d427f0932e93262b0a890eeec92a933.png] 

Now we compare each option with the last step obtained:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6a8dc924292c3e76eb439882c60d29bd9477bc2ca7fd79feaac81e9c1529d7e.png] The figure matches completely with the option.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3150d038d9fa16ff50e6afe2805b6fdfbe3999eae0771c5178b2428b469782d5.png] The central ring is connected with more than two rings. It is incorrect pattern. 

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3325b00031d977849390da47f3d833beb519a4b528a311b784de046e969f2230.png] The rings are connected with more than two rings. It is incorrect pattern. 

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04b2a781daf85b7fec8de8745166b4b15998f67917a901e2372adeaa27683d5f.png] The rings are connected with more than two rings. It is incorrect pattern.

**Hence** **the correct answer is option 1.**
